single H-bridge with IN1/IN2 and active-high ENABLE/PWM. Enabled 10 drives forward, 01 reverse, 00 brakes to GND and 11 brakes to VM; ENABLE low coasts. Inputs are local to GND: \u003c=0.8 V low, \u003e=2 V high. Intermediate levels use a smooth nonoverlapping conductance transition, not a valid digital state. Each active leg is 0.25 ohm with a 1 Gohm off path; four passive piecewise-linear clamp diodes remain active during coast and power-off (0.65 V knee plus 0.25 ohm). Input pulldowns are 1 Mohm; supply load is 100 kohm. Supply enable rises smoothly from 2 to 3 V; \u003c=2 V disables active legs. Bidirectional leg conduction and diode paths allow regenerative current into VM. No temporal dead time, propagation delay, gate charge, current limiting, thermal protection, switching loss, physical ratings or fitted manufacturer identity. Connect all controls and both supply pins; the supply must accommodate returned energy. The IC counts as one functional part within existing network bounds."},"led_model":{"id":"elab.generic-red-led.v1","is_a":1e-20,"n":2,"rs_ohm":1,"temperature_c":27,"limitations":"Educational generic diode; no physical part identity, reverse breakdown, thermal dynamics, ratings, or calibrated brightness."},"nmos_model":{"id":"elab.generic-nmos.v1","threshold_v":1.5,"beta_a_per_v2":0.1,"lambda_per_v":0.02,"body_diode":{"id":"elab.generic-silicon-diode.v1","is_a":1e-9,"n":1.7,"rs_ohm":1,"temperature_c":27,"limitations":"Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity."},"limitations":"Generic enhancement NMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and source-to-drain body diode. No contact noise, nonlinear taper, ratings, heating or physical part identity."},"power_model":{"id":"elab.power-and-isolation.v1","battery":"Linear charge reservoir: OCV=Vfull*q/Q; Q=3600*capacity_Ah; ESR voltage sag. Positive delivered current discharges; externally forced charging is an ideal reversible reservoir, not a charger model. Startup SOC is 0..1; live SOC outside that range is reported, not hidden.","motor":"Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load.
